[Viswanath family]

The matrices are
A_0 =
[[ 2,  1 ],
 [ 1,  1 ]]

A_1 =
[[ 1,  2 ],
 [ 0,  1 ]]

A_2 =
[[ 1,  0 ],
 [ 2,  1 ]]

A_3 =
[[ 1,  1 ],
 [ 1,  2 ]]

The probabilities are
pi_0 = (7-3*sqrt(5))/2,
pi_1 = sqrt(5)-2,
pi_2 = sqrt(5)-2,
pi_3 = (3-sqrt(5))/2.


This file contains the 587-constellation with 623 points for the family above.

The anchor is b = (1/2, 1/2).
We take a = b. Vectors are columns.

For a word w = w_1, ..., w_k, let y_w = A_w b, where A_w = A_{w_k} ... A_{w_1}, and write |y_w| to denote the sum of its entries. The bracketed word

[w_1, ..., w_k]

represents the point y_w/|y_w|. The empty bracketed word [] represents b.

Each point in the support of the constellation and its weight are displayed as

[word]
(exact rational weight)
